title: Special Issue: Why America Needs a Third Founding
gist: Hedgehog Review editor Jay Tolson introduces a special issue and the Institute for Advanced Studies in Culture's 'Third Founding' initiative, arguing that America's democratic crisis is fundamentally cultural rather than partisan. He catalogs eroding trust in civil-society institutions, widening inequality, shareholder-value-only corporations and AI as threats, and lays out six nonpartisan principles for renewing US political culture.
